name: JUST 0.1.0 — Windows installer host fix / Windows 安装器宿主修复
body:
## 下载 / Downloads

Windows 最新附件：`JUST-0.1.0-Windows-x64-preview-setup.exe`，**4,031,050 字节**。SHA-256：`22946543862a919f32621aabee3c00d294d97f6e11cb8e6c4e525a92373c1040`。

插件版本仍为 **0.1.0**，Windows 未签名预览，待实机验收。本次仅更新安装器，十个 DLL、151 项插件载荷、UI、DSP、参数和批准美术不变；旧 Release、附件和许可证保留。

- 修复未选中的第三方 reparse／链接目录误挡安装；这些目录不遍历、不修改。选中的 JUST bundle 为链接时仍拒绝。
- 同卷事务保留旧 bundle，宿主运行本身不再阻止安全安装和撤销。先保存工程；若插件编辑窗口锁住文件，会安全拒绝并保留原内容，关闭该编辑窗口后重试，不强制终止宿主。
- 完成后正常重新打开宿主或重新加载插件使用新副本；不承诺所有 DAW 无条件热替换或音频无间断。保留报告和事务备份，使用该事务原卸载器撤销。
- 最终 EXE 八项定向检查完成；复用此前安装器七项未受影响证据。两项无效恢复报告诊断在原生 PowerShell 克隆夹具中核对，未重跑完整 DSP/UI 矩阵。实际还原保留 153 文件、71 目录及对象身份；顶层目录修改时间有变化，原检查器误判记录保留并按原始记录核清。

[macOS Apple silicon arm64 PKG（原包未变）](https://github.com/Yeeeee0-0/just-audio-plugin-bundle/releases/download/v0.1.0-installers.20261012/JUST-Audio-Plugin-Bundle-0.1.0-macOS-arm64-b99abd3-selectable-unsigned.pkg)：11,254,806 字节，SHA-256 `c1359f53d5307ff994c4d8fd1e8930e0f8a5996c3140dc31a09fea69cc4f56cc`。未重新构建；仅 arm64，PKG 未签名、未公证。

## English

This unsigned **0.1.0 Windows x64 preview** changes only the installer. All ten DLLs, 151 payload files, UI, DSP, parameters and approved artwork remain unchanged. Previous releases/assets and licensing are preserved.

Unselected third-party linked directories no longer falsely block installation and are not traversed or modified. Same-volume transactions retain old bundles, allowing safe installation and undo while a host remains running when files can be moved. Save your project; a hard file lock safely refuses installation without terminating the host. Close the locking plugin editor and retry. Normally reopen the host or reload the plugin to use the installed copy. No universal DAW hot swapping or gap-free audio is promised.

Eight directed checks passed on the final EXE, with seven unaffected earlier-installer cases reused. Two invalid recovery-report cases were checked in native PowerShell clone fixtures. No full DSP/UI matrix was rerun. Restoration preserved the measured 153 files, 71 directories and recorded identities; the scan-root modification time changed. Original observer false-failure records remain preserved and reconciled against raw content/identity evidence. The linked macOS arm64 PKG is unchanged and was not rebuilt.

Matching Windows source is in this tag. See the [bilingual release record](https://github.com/Yeeeee0-0/just-audio-plugin-bundle/blob/v0.1.0-installers.20261013-host-fix/docs/releases/0.1.0-installers-20261013-host-fix.md), `release-manifest.json` and `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

name: JUST 0.1.0 — Windows UI fix & macOS arm64 / 双平台安装包
body:
## 下载 / Downloads

插件版本均为 **0.1.0**。推荐下载本页附件：
- Windows x64：`JUST-0.1.0-Windows-x64-preview-UI-fix-setup.exe`（最新 UI 修复预览包）。
- macOS Apple Silicon arm64：`JUST-Audio-Plugin-Bundle-0.1.0-macOS-arm64-b99abd3-selectable-unsigned.pkg`（已发布原包，字节未变）。
- 两端各含十款 VST3：EQ、Reverb、Delay、Tremolo、Compressor、Limiter、Gate、Flanger、Wider、Distortion。默认全选，可分别取消选择。

Both installers keep plugin version **0.1.0**. The Windows asset is the latest unsigned UI-fix preview; the macOS asset is the unchanged original Apple Silicon package. Both include the ten effects listed above, selected by default.

## 安装与卸载 / Install and uninstall

先保存工程并正常关闭使用 JUST 的音频宿主。Windows 使用 x64 VST3 目录（默认 Common Files/VST3）；保留安装报告和 ProgramData/ JUST 事务备份，使用该事务生成的卸载器恢复旧插件或移除首次安装项。macOS 安装到当前用户的 ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3；移除时仅移走该目录内对应 JUST 插件。勿删除宿主配置、许可证或个人工程。

Save projects and close hosts using JUST before installation. Windows provides a transaction-bound uninstaller and retains its backup. macOS installs to the current user's VST3 directory; remove only the corresponding JUST bundles when uninstalling.

## 本次变化与验证 / Changes and verification

Windows：更新批准的安装器图标和欢迎/完成页；修复模块下拉菜单瞬间关闭、选择回退及按钮重绘闪烁。DSP、参数与身份兼容契约、33ms 刷新和已核对的安装卸载逻辑保持原状态。

十款最终 x64 DLL 构建及有限范围原生 UI 检查通过；REAPER 7.41 定向八项通过（Flanger 六项、Delay 停止/播放两项）。新安装器展示、十项默认选择、隔离模拟安装、文件占用拒绝及卸载内容/目录恢复通过。沿用未改变逻辑的先前 51 项安装/40 项卸载证据，没有重跑全矩阵。新包物理 Cancel 按钮未重测；占用失败窗口经正常 WM_CLOSE 退出。卸载元数据并非全部恢复一致。

The Windows release fixes menu/selection stability and button painting, with approved installer artwork. Verification is bounded: ten native UI checks, eight directed REAPER checks, and isolated installer cases. It does not guarantee every DAW, audible DSP behavior, or all metadata restoration.

macOS：冻结 arm64 载荷与 ad-hoc 签名校验、安装包结构及选择界面已核对；PKG GUI 检查停在安装前确认，未执行该 PKG 的实际安装/升级或安装后扫描。本次未重编或重封装 macOS 包。

The macOS package is unchanged; its installer GUI was checked through pre-install confirmation. Actual PKG installation/upgrade and post-install scanning were not executed.

## 架构、签名与源码 / Platform, signing and source

Windows 插件为 AMD64；NSIS 启动器可为 x86。Windows 包与插件未签名。macOS 仅 arm64，插件为 ad-hoc 开发签名，PKG 无签名、未公证；没有 Intel/Universal 包。macOS 11.0 是构建部署目标，并非该版本运行验证承诺。

Windows VST3 payloads are x64 and unsigned. macOS is arm64 only: ad-hoc plugin signatures, unsigned and unnotarized PKG. No Intel/universal binary is included.

Windows 对应本发布 tag 的源码；macOS 原公开源码保持 [v0.1.0](https://github.com/Yeeeee0-0/just-audio-plugin-bundle/tree/v0.1.0)，提交 `f2a710510415395e13e548400143604c455df8fe`。MIT 许可及第三方通知保持不变。旧发布历史和资产保留。详见仓库中英 README、docs/releases/0.1.0-installers-20261012.md、SHA256SUMS.txt 和 release-manifest.json。

Windows SHA256: `4fd10096f4135fc1520875eb78eda7e5ff82347bcdd8f85b8bc52d23712d8bab`

macOS SHA256: `c1359f53d5307ff994c4d8fd1e8930e0f8a5996c3140dc31a09fea69cc4f56cc`

name: JUST 0.1.0 — macOS Apple Silicon
body:
Ten native VST3 audio effects for macOS Apple silicon: EQ, Reverb, Delay, Tremolo, Compressor, Limiter, Gate, Flanger, Wider and Distortion. Project code and authorized artwork are MIT licensed.

## Downloads

- Recommended: the selectable `.pkg` installer. All ten plugins are selected by default; each can be selected independently. Installation is for the current user.
- Manual installation: `JUST-0.1.0-macOS-arm64-VST3.zip`.
- Reviewed source: `JUST-0.1.0-source.zip`, with a complete file manifest in `SOURCE-SNAPSHOT.json`.
- See `INSTALLATION-GUIDE.md`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, `LICENSE.txt` and `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## Verified scope

The package uses the original frozen 0.1.0 binaries. The clean public source rebuilt all ten arm64 Release targets and passed eight shared CLI contract tests plus 32 identity/resource audit regressions. Installer GUI checks passed for default-all, single/mixed selections, restoring all choices, current-user scope and the pre-install confirmation page; that check stopped before installation.

The installer SHA-256 is `c1359f53d5307ff994c4d8fd1e8930e0f8a5996c3140dc31a09fea69cc4f56cc`.

## Platform and signing limits

Only macOS arm64 binaries are included. The PKG is unsigned and not notarized; plugin bundles have ad-hoc development signatures. macOS 11.0 is the build deployment target, not a verified runtime claim. Intel/universal builds and Windows binaries are unverified. Windows porting work is not part of this stable release.

Full feature changes and known behavior limits: [release notes](https://github.com/Yeeeee0-0/just-audio-plugin-bundle/blob/v0.1.0/RELEASE_NOTES_0.1.0.md). Reproducible build steps and pinned SDK revisions: [BUILDING.md](https://github.com/Yeeeee0-0/just-audio-plugin-bundle/blob/v0.1.0/BUILDING.md).

name: JUST 0.1.0 Windows x64 preview 17 — 待实机验证
body:
# JUST 0.1.0 Windows x64 preview 17

**Unsigned Windows UI fix candidate; real REAPER playback/scale and bypass-color revalidation remains pending.**

Preview.13 has a reported REAPER 7.41 access violation in COMCTL32.dll while changing EQ overlay scale during playback. This candidate is based on `d0abf4f71c5a4b56e68a1441edf4dfc11dee8d04` and keeps scale/language/preset combo HWNDs alive through selection notifications, updating their UI in place. CI additionally captured a native button crash after Delete rebuilt the modal inside its click notification. Destructive modal button/Escape actions are now queued on the surviving editor window, with stale-action generation checks. The native grayscale wrapper also repaints bypassed controls after direct native state/text setters, addressing the reported blue Limiter checkbox. The earlier sibling-clipping fix is retained. DSP, plugin IDs, parameters, state formats and Mac code are unchanged.

The native host now observes sender destruction (including handle reuse), verifies real common-control keyboard selection and host resize rejection, exercises user/factory preset selection, and performs 16 modal/view/scale cycles per plugin while actual float32/float64 DLL audio processing continues on a separate thread with unchanged twin output. Every native button click is also observed for sender lifetime, and eight Escape callbacks per plugin must preserve their sender until returning. The same new test host rejects the pinned preview.13 EQ DLL at both combo and explicit button-notification lifetime assertions. Limiter additionally verifies native checkbox state, text, lifetime and unchanged automation after setters, with immediate and post-refresh offscreen captures. These are hidden-window native tests, not physical input or real REAPER acceptance; live native themed animation/color remains unverified.

本包修复候选针对 preview.13 播放中切换 EQ 浮层缩放时的 COMCTL32.dll 崩溃：下拉框选择通知改为原位更新，不在其回调尚未返回时销毁控件。CI 另定位到按钮点击中同步重建浮层的同类崩溃，现将破坏性浮层按钮与 Escape 操作排到回调返回后执行，并过滤过期操作。另补上 Limiter 等原生控件设置状态后的旁路灰度重绘。请在 REAPER 7.41、175% DPI 下重新检查十款播放中缩放、语言／预设切换、浮层开关和重复操作，以及 Limiter 勾选框旁路后立即、悬停、点击和等待刷新时的黑白显示；保留旧测试证据，单独记录本包结果。实机确认前不作为正式版。

- Download `JUST-0.1.0-Windows-x64-preview.17-Setup.exe` for the selectable installer (all ten selected by default).
- `Portable.zip` contains the exact ten tested x64 VST3 bundles and installation scripts.
- `Source.zip` is the complete public source and runtime artwork. Fetch the pinned official SDK with `scripts/bootstrap-sdk.py` when rebuilding.
- Download `SHA256SUMS.txt`, `preview-manifest.json`, the Chinese Codex prompt, acceptance checklist, and known differences as well.

Native Windows build, 69 CTest cases, ten official VST3 validator runs, and 51 isolated installer checks passed. See the [workflow evidence](https://github.com/Yeeeee0-0/just-audio-plugin-bundle/actions/runs/37843968606) and Evidence.zip.

Source: `7aedc756b90f3489a1cf2cc0e8e75816fac08b16`. Plugin version `0.1.0`; vendor `Yee Huang`; VST3 AMD64 only. The setup bootstrap may be a 32-bit NSIS executable; the plugin payload is x64.

The installer verifies payloads, backs up selected previous JUST bundles, and restores them after an installation failure. Save work and close REAPER normally before installation. No user preset, REAPER configuration, license, or project is edited by the installer.

This candidate has not yet been tested in the user's Windows REAPER session. Earlier preview.12/13 observations do not constitute acceptance of these rebuilt files. GUI/input, high-DPI, presets, automation, and audible DSP acceptance must be checked on the Windows computer. Custom rotary controls include a native UI Automation provider and a required native client test; real screen-reader acceptance remains pending. This preview is not a claim of Mac/Windows visual parity or production readiness.

The stable macOS `main` branch and `v0.1.0` release are unchanged. This is a prerelease and is not marked latest.
